name: charter-ts
description: charter-ts keeps a repo the charter way: issues, docs, ci, upstream, repo, adopt, new; a repo's npm scripts run them, each the command of its name. A project's steps (charter.toml) are charter's, the Go command: mise use github:joeblew999/charter. A TypeScript Worker imports charter-lib (ts).

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: tsc && node --test src/*.test.ts && npm run build
